hook: This fighter jet stops in midair and lands straight down.
narration: This fighter jet is about to stop in midair and land straight down.
It is an F-35B, flown by Marines at Air Station Yuma, Arizona, in April 2021.
Behind the cockpit, a door opens over a big fan that blows straight down.
At the tail, the engine nozzle swivels down, and together they hold the jet up like a helicopter.
A Marine on the runway watched each one come in, radio in hand.
outcome: One after another, the jets settled onto the runway in a cloud of dust.

title: F-35B stops midair, lands straight down
description:
F-35B Lightning II jets with Marine Fighter Attack Squadron 122 practiced vertical landings at Marine Corps Air Station Yuma, Arizona, on April 6, 2021.
